question: What is the average score in writing for the schools that were opened after 1991 or closed before 2000? List the school names along with the score. Also, list the communication number of the schools if there is any.
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "schools_scores_profiles" AS SELECT
  t1.cds AS cds_code,
  t2.school AS school_name,
  t1.avgscrwrite AS avg_writing_score,
  t2.opendate AS open_date,
  t2.closeddate AS close_date,
  t2.phone AS communication_phone,
  t2.ext AS phone_extension
FROM table_1 AS t1
JOIN table_2 AS t2
  ON t1.cds = t2.cdscode

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "conductor_s_execution" AS
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    school_name,
    avg_writing_score,
    open_date,
    close_date,
    CASE WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(communication_phone, '')) = '' THEN NULL ELSE TRIM(communication_phone) END AS phone,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(CAST(phone_extension AS VARCHAR), ''), '[^0-9]', '') AS ext_digits
  FROM "schools_scores_profiles"
), years AS (
  SELECT
    school_name,
    avg_writing_score,
    phone,
    NULLIF(TRIM(ext_digits), '') AS ext,
    CAST(NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(open_date, '(\d{4})'), '') AS INTEGER) AS open_year,
    CAST(NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(close_date, '(\d{4})'), '') AS INTEGER) AS close_year
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  school_name,
  avg_writing_score AS average_writing_score,
  CASE
    WHEN phone IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN ext IS NULL THEN phone
    ELSE phone || ' x' || ext
  END AS communication_number
FROM years
WHERE (open_year IS NOT NULL AND open_year > 1991)
   OR (close_year IS NOT NULL AND close_year < 2000)
ORDER BY school_name
LIMIT 10;
